verdict.rationale: Paxos documents single transfers, fiat withdrawals, and orchestrations that convert and transfer 'in one call'. Those are single-payout flows combined with a conversion, not a batch or bulk operation pushing many payouts at once. Listing and polling transfers gives per-transfer status, but no batch or mass-disbursement endpoint is documented, so the axis applies yet is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can run mass disbursements — batch or bulk payout APIs that push many stablecoin or fiat payouts in one documented operation with per-item status
